Problem Statement
Read an integer N and print all numbers from 1 to N, each on a new line, using a for loop.
Description
Read an integer N from input. Use a for loop that starts a counter at 1, continues as long as the counter is less than or equal to N, and increases the counter by 1 after each iteration. Print the counter's value on each iteration.
Input Description
A single integer N (N >= 1).
Output Description
Print the numbers from 1 to N, each on its own line.
Sample Input
5

1
